title: AgriFoodData model
description: Machine-readable specification of the data model for digital agriculture and farm management systems: 47 entities in 14 packages, bound to the classes and properties of the agrifooddata ontology.

recommendation.title: Data model for digital agriculture and farm management systems
recommendation.status: draft, revision 3, proposed to ITU-T Study Group 20
recommendation.precedence: In the event of a discrepancy between the Recommendation and this machine-readable specification or the ontology, the text of the Recommendation takes precedence (clause 8).

conventions.title: Primary key
conventions.text: Every entity carries an id holding a UUID, which serves as its primary key and permits decentralized creation and conflict-free synchronization.

conventions.title: System timestamps
conventions.text: Every entity carries createdAt and updatedAt, set by the system. Concurrent modifications are resolved per attribute on a last-write-wins basis using updatedAt; a conflict affecting documentation that has already been reported is resolved through the correction path, by recording the change in the AuditLog together with a reason.

conventions.title: Time
conventions.text: Timestamps are stored in accordance with ISO 8601-1 in coordinated universal time. The time zone used for presentation is given by Farm.timezone.

conventions.title: Geometry
conventions.text: Every geometry attribute holds a GeoJSON geometry object (RFC 7946) in WGS 84 and can be served through OGC API - Features.

conventions.title: Semantic type identifiers
conventions.text: typeUri and every other attribute whose name ends in Uri hold dereferenceable URIs of canonical vocabularies, AGROVOC being the primary one. Codes of other systems are bound to canonical concepts through CodeMapping.

conventions.title: Self-description
conventions.text: Field, Region, Site, Machine, Device, Data, ProcessingService and Result should carry a description holding a W3C WoT Thing Description in JSON-LD. The attribute is optional; where present, its content conforms to WoT-TD.

conventions.title: External synchronization
conventions.text: Organization, Farm, Field, Machine, Animal, Product and Device may carry externalId and externalProvider to reference records of external systems persistently.

conventions.title: Exclusive references
conventions.text: Where an entity offers alternative references to different parent entities, exactly one of them is set.

conventions.title: Retention of operational records
conventions.text: Operational records are withdrawn from use by a terminal status or an endsAt timestamp rather than deleted, and every change is recorded in the append-only AuditLog. Personal data in User and Worker are erased or pseudonymized where the law requires it, while identifiers and operational references are retained.

conventions.title: Units and currencies
conventions.text: Attributes named unit should use UCUM codes. Currencies are ISO 4217 codes, countries ISO 3166-1 codes, languages BCP 47 tags.

conventions.title: Naming
conventions.text: Entity names in PascalCase, attribute names in camelCase, foreign keys named <entity>Id.

conventions.title: Provenance
conventions.text: Every entity carries originType, createdByUserId, createdByJobId and clientId, set by the system and not modified after creation. Where originType is USER, createdByUserId is set; where it is SERVICE, createdByJobId is set.

packages.title: Party, Users and Access
packages.scope: Multi-tenancy, roles and access, personnel master data
packages.summary: This package provides the foundation for multi-tenancy, access to several holdings, role-based access control and personnel master data. It distinguishes between the User, a person who interacts with the system through an account, and the Worker, a person who performs work on the holding and who may have no system account, such as a seasonal worker or the driver of a contractor.
notes: Fine-grained policies that depend on attributes or on the purpose of processing remain in the external identity and access management system (clause 10). Role and AccessAssignment provide the base layer within the model itself and are evaluated in addition to, never in place of, those policies.

packages.title: Farm and Sites
packages.scope: Holding structure, built and technical locations
packages.summary: This package contains the central Farm entity, which acts as the primary anchor for all agricultural operations and for the assignment of access rights, together with the built and technical locations of the holding.

packages.title: Fields and Geospatial Data
packages.scope: Field boundaries, management zones, spatial reference
packages.summary: This package defines the geospatial structure of the holding and the physical layout of the land.
notes: Default region convention: every Field has exactly one Region of the default type, whose geometry corresponds to the field boundary. All references from cultivation and data entities are thereby directed uniformly at Region, without a special case for operations that concern the whole field (rule V05).

A Region lies within the boundary of exactly one Field and does not span several fields; regions of the same field may overlap. An area of interest that crosses field boundaries is represented as a separate Region in each field concerned.

In speciality crop production, vine rows, tree rows and beds are represented through Region.typeUri together with parentRegionId. Spatial references within protected cultivation are represented through Site.

packages.title: Cropping Planning and Cultivation
packages.scope: Crop planning, crop rotation, perennial plantings, cultivation cycles
packages.summary: This package separates what is intended from what has occurred. CroppingPlan and CroppingPlanEntry express the intended assignment of crops to regions for a harvest year; CultivationPeriod records the cultivation that actually took place; and Stand represents the multi-year life cycle of a perennial planting.
notes: Crop rotation is not an entity. It is the temporal sequence of CroppingPlanEntry and CultivationPeriod records for a given Region across harvest years (clause 7.4).

Where cultivation cycles overlap in time on the same region, each cycle is a separate CultivationPeriod. For a perennial planting, a CultivationPeriod represents the annual vegetative cycle of a Stand.

packages.title: Work and Operations Management
packages.scope: Work orders, field record keeping, resource deployment, working time
packages.summary: This package models the work carried out on the holding. It covers the ordering of work (Task), its documentation (Activity), the resources deployed (ActivityResource) and the working time recorded (TimeRecord). Together these entities constitute the electronic field record.

packages.title: Products and Inventory
packages.scope: Inputs and produce, lots, stock movements, traceability
packages.summary: This package covers the master data of all inputs and produce and the movements of stock. It is the anchor for regulatory information attached to products and for traceability from the field to the customer.
notes: Stock levels are not stored. They are derived from the StockMovement records for a combination of product, lot and storage location (clause 7.5; derived view stock-level).

packages.title: Machinery and Equipment
packages.summary: This package covers machines and implements, including their machine-level identity and their attachment to telemetry.
notes: Live telemetry, such as position, machine states and diagnostic codes, is not duplicated as an entity. It is attached through Device and Observation, or referenced at an external interface.
Machinery held in common by several holdings may be represented through a separate Organization and Farm.

packages.title: Animal Husbandry
packages.scope: Herd and animal management, animal events, feeding
packages.summary: This package models animal husbandry. Its design is event-oriented: occurrences are recorded through a single generic AnimalEvent entity rather than through a separate entity per type of occurrence, and the event types are aligned with ICAR ADE. Notifications required by an authority are generated from these events as specified in clause 8.11.
notes: Performance indicators such as lactation yield, calving interval, daily weight gain and replacement rate are derived views over AnimalEvent and Observation records, not entities.

Sensors carried by animals and equipment such as milking installations are represented through Device and Observation. Feed actually consumed is recorded as InputOutput with an animal or animal group reference, so that plan and outcome can be compared.

packages.title: Observations and Data
packages.scope: Sensors, weather, measurements, datasets and files
packages.summary: This package covers structured individual measurements, the devices that produce them, and the datasets and files associated with the holding. Weather data, soil sensing, animal sensing and machine telemetry are thereby modelled uniformly.
notes: Scaling convention: high-frequency raw time series remain in a dedicated time series backend or an OGC SensorThings service, referenced through Device.sensorThingsUrl or through Data and File. Observation holds consolidated values relevant to decisions or documentation.
Weather convention: weather data are Observation records whose source identifies the weather service and whose feature of interest is a Field or a Site. There is no weather entity.

Sampling and scouting convention: a soil sample is a Data record of the corresponding DataType with a Region reference and capturedAt, the laboratory report a File; each analysed parameter is an Observation referencing the Data record, with the time of sampling as phenomenonTime. Scouting is recorded as Observation records whose observedPropertyUri identifies the pest or disease.

packages.title: Economics
packages.scope: Quantities, monetary valuation, budgets, gross margin
packages.summary: This package records the quantities consumed and produced and their monetary valuation, across crop production and animal husbandry alike.
notes: The gross margin of a CultivationPeriod or an AnimalGroup is a derived view, not an entity (derived view gross-margin).

packages.title: Compliance and Audit
packages.summary: This package covers formal reporting to authorities and certification bodies, the certification status of the holding, and the record of changes. Reports are generated from the operational data, which remain the single authoritative source.
notes: The audit log records the history of changes at the level of individual attributes. How a record came into being is recorded separately, through the provenance attributes every entity carries (clause 5.1 l)).

packages.title: Data Processing and Decision Support
packages.scope: Processing services and runs, analytics, decision support, provenance anchor
packages.summary: This package provides a generic execution framework for all data processing services, from deterministic transformations, aggregations, validations, ingestion runs and report generation through to machine learning inference and analysis supported by language models. The use of artificial intelligence is a property of a service, indicated by the aiBased attribute, and not a precondition. The package is also the provenance anchor of the model: every automatic creation of data shall be executed as a ProcessingJob of a registered ProcessingService.
notes: Every automatic creation of data — analysis, transformation, aggregation, validation, ingestion, synchronization or report generation — is executed as a ProcessingJob of a registered ProcessingService, so that any automatically created record can be traced to the run that produced it (clause 7.6).

The loop of the digital twin: a Result, for example a prescription map, gives rise to a Task through sourceResultId; the Task is carried out as an Activity; its effect returns as Observation and InputOutput records (clause 7.1).

packages.title: Sustainability
packages.scope: Environmental and sustainability indicators, monitoring, reporting and verification
packages.summary: This package holds sustainability indicators that are calculated or recorded for a defined scope and period, together with the method used and, where applicable, the body that verified them. It provides the basis for monitoring, reporting and verification of environmental performance and for supplying sustainability information to reporting frameworks.
notes: The run that calculated an indicator follows from the provenance attributes, and the parameters of that run permit the calculation to be reproduced. The registration and trading of certificates derived from indicators are outside the scope of the model.

packages.title: Semantics and Interoperability
packages.scope: Binding of canonical concepts to external code systems
packages.summary: This package links the data model to external vocabularies and code systems. The typeUri pattern and the self-description convention of clause 5.1 apply across all packages; this package specifies the entity that binds canonical concepts to code systems that are not URI-based.
notes: CodeMapping binds, among others, crops to EPPO codes, plant protection products to authorization numbers, operations and measured quantities to ISO 11783 data dictionary identifiers, animal events to ICAR ADE codes and growth stages to the BBCH scale.
Because concept URIs carry labels in several languages, the same data can be presented in different languages without altering the stored data.

Organization.definition: The Organization entity shall represent a legal entity, such as a farming business, a cooperative, a contracting business, an advisory service, a laboratory, a veterinary practice, a trading partner, a certification body or a public authority. Within a given deployment it is the top-level container for all other data; in a federated environment each participating organization maintains its own Organization root.

V01.text: For every period, the closing value (endsAt, validTo, periodEnd) shall be greater than or equal to the opening value (startsAt, validFrom, periodStart) where both are set.

V02.text: Quantities (amount, quantity, dosage, area, capacity, headCount) shall be greater than zero. Economics.value may be negative, in order to permit credits and corrections.

V03.text: Exclusive references shall set exactly one of the permitted references. This applies to InputOutput, Observation, Data, Economics, AnimalEvent, ActivityResource and ProcessingJobInput.

V04.text: Where originType is USER, createdByUserId shall be set. Where originType is SERVICE, createdByJobId shall be set.

V05.text: Every Field shall have exactly one default Region, whose geometry corresponds to Field.geometry.

V06.text: Region.geometry should lie within Field.geometry, subject to a defined tolerance, and Activity.geometry should lie within the geometry of the spatial unit referenced.

V07.text: Several CultivationPeriod records may exist in parallel for the same Region, in order to represent mixed cropping, undersowing and agroforestry. Where planEntryId is set, typeUri should correspond to CroppingPlanEntry.cropUri.

V08.text: Stand.clearingDate shall be greater than or equal to Stand.plantingDate, and CultivationPeriod.standId shall reference a Stand of the same Region.

V09.text: An Activity whose typeUri denotes the application of a plant protection product shall have at least one associated InputOutput referencing a Product of category PLANT_PROTECTION. The bbchStage attribute should be set, and the person recorded through ActivityResource should hold a valid certificate of competence in Worker.certifications.

V10.text: An InputOutput referencing a Product of category PLANT_PROTECTION or VETERINARY_MEDICINE shall set productId, so that the authorization number and the withdrawal period are resolvable.

V11.text: Where a treatment AnimalEvent references a product for which withdrawalPeriodDays is set, withdrawalUntilMilk and withdrawalUntilMeat shall be calculated and stored. A departure or delivery event occurring before the end of that period shall raise a blocking warning.

V12.text: A StockMovement should not cause the derived stock level for a combination of productId, lotId and storageLocationId to become negative. Movements of type ADJUSTMENT are exempt.

V13.text: A Lot shall set at most one origin of own production, either originCultivationPeriodId or originAnimalGroupId. Purchased lots shall instead set supplierOrganizationId.

V14.text: New references to records that have been withdrawn from use, whether by a terminal status value or by an endsAt timestamp in the past, should be prevented. References that already exist shall remain valid.

V15.text: A RegulatoryReport shall be immutable from the status SUBMITTED onwards. Corrections shall be made only through a new report referencing the earlier one through supersedesReportId.

V16.text: Periods of validity of AccessAssignment records shall not overlap for the same combination of userId, farmId and roleId.

businessKeys.text: Exactly one default Region per fieldId (rule V05).
together with the origin reference for own production

derivedViews.title: Stock level
derivedViews.text: The sum of the StockMovement records for a combination of productId, lotId and storage location.
derivedViews.rule: A movement adds its quantity to the level at toStorageLocationId and subtracts it from the level at fromStorageLocationId, per productId, lotId and unit. A movement without a storage location on one side does not affect a level on that side. Levels in different units are not added up.

derivedViews.title: Gross margin
derivedViews.text: For a CultivationPeriod or an AnimalGroup: the sum of the Economics records associated with output quantities, less the sum of those associated with input quantities and with the machine and labour resources deployed in the corresponding operations. Where an Economics record is absent, the imputed rates Machine.costRatePerHour and Worker.costRatePerHour, multiplied by the duration recorded in ActivityResource, should be used instead.

derivedViews.title: Nutrient balance
derivedViews.text: Derived from InputOutput records together with Product.composition.

derivedViews.title: Animal performance indicators
derivedViews.text: Lactation yield, calving interval, daily weight gain, replacement rate and the like, derived from AnimalEvent and Observation records.

derivedViews.title: Crop rotation
derivedViews.text: The temporal sequence of CroppingPlanEntry and CultivationPeriod records for a given Region across harvest years. Rules governing the sequence are validation logic applied to it, not structures of the model.

ontology.finding: Clause 7.2 admits domain-specific vocabularies alongside AGROVOC "provided that the concepts they express are mapped to AGROVOC concepts". The ontology maps its schemes crops and pests in part, in the link set links/agrovoc.ttl, where AGROVOC names a concept as the ontology does; the rest of them, and the stages of phenology, carry no mapping. They are values of CultivationPeriod.typeUri, CroppingPlanEntry.cropUri, Stand.cropUri, Observation.observedPropertyUri and Activity.bbchStage.
ontology.resolution: None here; the remaining mappings belong in the ontology, which lists them as a gap of its own.

recommendation.subject: Machine.description
recommendation.finding: Clauses 5.1 f) and 9 list Machine among the entities with a self-description; the table in Annex A.23 has no description attribute.
recommendation.resolution: Included, optional, holding a Thing Description, with the source noted on the attribute.

recommendation.subject: ProcessingService.typeUri
recommendation.finding: Clause 8.12 and Annex B require a typeUri where serviceType is CUSTOM; the table in Annex A.42 has no such attribute.
recommendation.resolution: Included, optional; its presence where serviceType is CUSTOM is checked as a "should".

recommendation.subject: Stand.description, Result.description
recommendation.finding: Annex A.13 describes Stand.description as a Thing Description, although clause 5.1 f) does not list Stand; Annex A.45 describes Result.description merely as a description, although clause 5.1 f) lists Result.
recommendation.resolution: Both are read as Thing Descriptions — the reading that follows from either source.

recommendation.subject: RegulatoryReport.status
recommendation.finding: Table 4 permits REJECTED → GENERATED "where the report is regenerated", while rule V15 makes a report immutable from SUBMITTED onwards and admits corrections only through a new report.
recommendation.resolution: The transition is kept as Table 4 lists it; the conflict is for the Recommendation to resolve.

recommendation.subject: Stock level
recommendation.finding: Clauses 7.5 and 8.6 derive stock levels per productId, lotId and storageLocationId, but StockMovement has no storageLocationId — it has fromStorageLocationId and toStorageLocationId.
recommendation.resolution: A movement adds to the level at its destination and subtracts from the level at its origin (rules.yaml, derived view stock-level).

recommendation.subject: Budget.scopeType COST_CATEGORY
recommendation.finding: scopeRefId is a UUID "referring to the object identified by scopeType", but a cost category is a concept (costCategoryUri), not a record, and Budget has no attribute to hold it.
recommendation.resolution: None; for COST_CATEGORY, scopeRefId has no defined target.

recommendation.subject: Region.area
recommendation.finding: Field carries area and areaUnit, Region only area — its unit is not stated.

recommendation.subject: Appendix II
recommendation.finding: The Thing Description in Appendix II does not conform to WoT TD 1.1: it lacks the mandatory securityDefinitions and security, its property affordances lack forms, `value` is not a member of a property affordance, the prefix td is not defined, and the AGROVOC namespace is given as a JSON-LD context, which it is not.
recommendation.resolution: The example of a Field in examples/ carries a Thing Description that does conform.

recommendation.subject: Appendix III
recommendation.finding: Four of the eight AGROVOC identifiers in Appendix III name other concepts: c_5979 is "plant resources" (not ploughing), c_6954 "Selenomonas" (not seeding), c_3533 "Hedysarum coronarium" (not harvesting), c_5192 "nitrogen" (not nitrogen fertilizers). Checked against the AGROVOC service on 2026-09-26.
recommendation.resolution: The Recommendation should read c_6021 (ploughing), c_7268 (sowing), c_3500 (harvesting) and c_5195 (nitrogen fertilizers). The ontology already uses c_7268 and c_3500 in activity-types.

recommendation.subject: ISO 3166-1
recommendation.finding: Country codes shall conform to ISO 3166-1 (clause 5.1 j)), which defines alpha-2, alpha-3 and numeric codes; the Recommendation does not say which.
recommendation.resolution: All three forms are accepted; alpha-2 is recommended in the descriptions.

recommendation.subject: Lot.supplierOrganizationId
recommendation.finding: Rule V13 requires purchased lots to set supplierOrganizationId, but whether a lot was purchased is not recorded in the lot itself.
recommendation.resolution: At most one origin of own production is checked on the record; the supplier requirement is left to the interface layer.
